title: Russia to pay schoolgirls to have children to boost birth rates
description: Russian authorities are offering to pay schoolgirls $1,200 to have children in a desperate attempt to boost the country's birth rate after it lost a reported quarter of a million soldiers in the Ukraine War meat grinder.

title: Russia says Ukraine ceasefire talks ‘useful’, but no concrete plans yet
description: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said that Russia and the US were analysing the discussions held in Saudi Arabia on Monday

title: Ukraine war latest: Trump says 'we're talking about territory' in Russia talks update - as Zelenskyy speaks out on White House row
description: Donald Trump has spoken about talks in the Saudi city of Riyadh today as efforts to end the Ukraine war continue. Volodymyr Zelenskyy has also given a revealing interview. Follow the latest, submit a question for defence analyst Michael Clarke and listen to The World podcast below.

title: U.S. and Russian negotiators launch ceasefire talks in Saudi Arabia
description: U.S. negotiators worked on a proposed partial ceasefire in Ukraine on Monday, meeting with representatives from Russia a day after holding separate talks with the Ukrainian team. Each side has accused the other of undermining efforts to reach a pause in the three-year-old war.

title: Ukraine war latest: Putin's gift to Trump revealed as ceasefire talks focus on Black Sea; Ukraine on attack in Russia
description: Russian and US officials are holding talks in the Saudi city of Riyadh today as efforts to end the Ukraine war continue. Follow the latest here - and submit a question for defence analyst Michael Clarke below. Listen to The World podcast as you scroll.

title: US-Russia talks begin in Saudi Arabia about Ukraine war, focus on Black Sea ceasefire
description: Earlier, the US delegation held talks with Ukraine officials in Saudi Arabia on Sunday as President Donald Trump intensified his efforts to strike a deal between Russia and Ukraine.

title: Ukraine war ceasefire talks begin in Saudi Arabia as Russia continues attacks
description: The US says a maritime ceasefire in the Black Sea will be the primary aim of the talks in Riyadh.

title: Austria says it has uncovered a Russian-steered campaign to spread disinformation about Ukraine
description: Austrian authorities say they uncovered a Russian-steered campaign aimed at spreading disinformation about Ukraine following the detention in December of a Bulgarian woman accused of spying for Russia.

title: U.S. talks with Ukraine, Russia begin in Saudi Arabia as Zelenskyy calls for "more pressure" on Putin
description: U.S. officials are meeting separately with Ukrainian and Russian officials in hopes of hammering out a partial ceasefire in the 3-year war in Ukraine.

title: Russia Map Shows Rare Earth Minerals as Moscow Courts Trump
description: To end the war with Ukraine, Russia could offer the U.S. access to rare earth deposits in Ukraine that it does not legally have the right to give away.
